high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for a tour titled "A Madison Beer Christmas." The poster features a stylized illustration of a woman with dark hair, wearing a white strapless dress, framed within an ornate, vintage-style mirror. The mirror has a red ribbon tied around its top, adding a festive touch. Below the mirror, there is a green wreath with a star at its center, further emphasizing the holiday theme. The poster lists several cities and dates where the tour will be taking place: Dallas: December 3, 2024 Los Angeles: December 6, 2024
